note: Two lists, checked by ci:boundary-sanity against data/boundary-sanity.json. `allowed`: polygons that are wrong or unchecked and await correction; the community pages read this list as their one trust rule (lib/communities/community-outline.ts), so an outline listed here is read by nothing on the page, not the map and not the homes list, and each entry says why in `evidence`. `verified`: polygons over thresholdAcres that are genuinely this large, each with the acres it was checked at, its source and the evidence; when the measured acres move more than 1% the polygon changed and the entry fails until it is checked again. Shrunk 2026-09-25 from 24 slugs (the 2026-06-14 oversized set) after the 2026-08-23 rebuilds from county plats: broken-top, crosswater, northwest-crossing, pronghorn, vandevert-ranch and widgi-creek now measure under the threshold, and every remaining community outline is an authoritative county line.

evidence.bend-boyd-acres: City of Bend GIS Neighborhood Districts OBJECTID=8 measures 3,007 acres on the spheroid, but the layer's own Acres attribute says 2,390.29: a 25.8% gap no other district shows (the rest sit within 8%). Unexplained, so not verified. A Bend district, not a community outline: no community page reads it.

sunriver.source: Deschutes County GIS Unincorporated Communities (COMMUNITY=SUNRIVER); minus Crosswater plat sliver (20260823240000)
sunriver.evidence: The county's own community line around the resort, not a listing hull. Registry verification 2026-08-26: all 30 Sunriver MLS sub-area names sit 89.7% to 100% inside it.

three-rivers.source: Deschutes County GIS Subdivisions (ST_Union of Deschutes River Recreation Homesites plats) (20260823240000)
three-rivers.evidence: Recorded plats, and smaller than the 4,819-acre Three Rivers census-designated place, not larger: it under-draws the community (8 of the 11 registry aliases sit outside it, registry verification 2026-08-26). Correct as far as it goes; widening it to the CDP is a separate open item.

eagle-crest.source: Deschutes County GIS Subdivisions (ST_Union of Eagle Crest plats, including Ridge at Eagle Crest) (20260823210000)
eagle-crest.evidence: The union of the recorded Eagle Crest plats, the Ridge at Eagle Crest phases included. Registry verification 2026-08-26: Ridge At Eagle Crest 201 of 201 listings inside.

black-butte-ranch.source: Deschutes County GIS Subdivisions (ST_Union of Black Butte Ranch plats) (20260823210000), plus the Country House condominium's assessor parcels 140909AA9xxxx (20260925033420)
black-butte-ranch.evidence: The union of the ranch's recorded homesite sections; the containment list is 54 plats, every one named '... Of Black Butte Ranch' (registry verification 2026-08-26). Plus the Country House condominium, 4.51 acres, on the registry's MLS City evidence (Matt 2026-09-25: condo tracts join the outline).
